doc: A boundary (design/boundary.md): the world it invents beyond a playable region. A quadtree of terrain nodes, each a grid of heights with its own image, refined only where a player inside the region could ever see the difference, that the runtime draws as a cut by distance with each vertex morphing toward its parent's surface (draw.terrain); the rim's dressing (cliff faces, trunks and crowns, reeds, stones, beaches) as an ordinary mesh; and the walls that keep the player in.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: The highest point, metres.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: The reach from the origin, metres.

fields.name: rim_cells
fields.doc: Cells in the resolved hull.

fields.name: rim_length
fields.doc: The rim's length, metres.

fields.name: guide_lines
fields.doc: The hull's cells outlined, for the viewer: segment pairs.

fields.name: guide_colors
fields.doc: Each guide segment's colour by its cell's edge, packed RGBA.

fields.name: fire_points
fields.doc: Where its forests and jungles burn, metres (blaze points).

fields.name: fire_configs
fields.doc: Each fire point's fire config (fire_v1_config's id).

fields.name: fire_lit
fields.doc: Each fire point: 0, only while the boundary burns.

fields.name: node_min
fields.doc: Each terrain node's box, its low corner, metres (node 0 is the root).

fields.name: node_max
fields.doc: Each terrain node's box, its high corner, metres.

fields.name: node_children
fields.doc: Each node's four children (4 per node: -x-z, +x-z, -x+z, +x+z), 4294967295 where it has none (inside the region, or never needed).

fields.name: node_spacing
fields.doc: Each node's grid spacing, metres: the runtime refines a node nearer than a multiple of it.

fields.name: node_first
fields.doc: Each node's first index in terrain_indices.

fields.name: node_count
fields.doc: Each node's index count (0: nothing of its own, inside the region).

fields.name: terrain_positions
fields.doc: Terrain vertices, metres: every node's grid and the skirts down its sides.

fields.name: terrain_normals
fields.doc: Terrain vertex normals.

fields.name: terrain_uvs
fields.doc: Each terrain vertex's place in its node's image, u, v pairs (0 to 1, at texel centres).

fields.name: terrain_morph
fields.doc: Each terrain vertex's rise to its parent's surface, metres: the runtime morphs it there as the node nears its parent's distance.

fields.name: terrain_indices
fields.doc: Terrain triangles, by node.

fields.name: image_size
fields.doc: Each node's image is image_size x image_size texels.

fields.name: images
fields.doc: Every node's image, node after node, row after row (+z down the rows, +x along them), packed RGBA: alpha 255 on most ground, toward 0 on steep rock (a top-down image smears down a cliff, so the runtime lays strata there by height).

fields.name: positions
fields.doc: The dressing's vertex positions, metres.

fields.name: normals
fields.doc: The dressing's vertex normals.

fields.name: indices
fields.doc: The dressing's triangles.

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: The dressing's vertex colour, packed RGBA.

fields.name: figures
fields.doc: Trees and bushes within the figure range, for the game to fill (design/boundary.md, Figures).

fields.name: collision
fields.doc: What keeps the player in: the walls along the rim and the floor of the hull's cells (solid), and its trunks (solid).
